facts.text: The README warns that this module controls potentially Class 4 lasers.
The README describes a convenience wrapper around the Toptica laser SDK for controlling a Toptica CTL laser with a DLCpro.
DLCcontrol controls a Toptica DLCpro over an Ethernet connection.
DLCcontrol builds the Toptica SDK NetworkConnection and DLCpro in __init__ and calls open() unless open_on_init is false.
emission, emission_button and current_enabled read the DLC emission state, the emission button and the diode current enable; the current_enabled setter is documented as controlling emission on/off.
The service user level prompts for interactive confirmation on stdin and uses a per-unit service password.
get_user_level reads the connection user level; the set_user_level docstring says 3 is normal, 2 maintenance and 1 service.
wavelength_actual and wavelength_setpoint read the laser wavelength; the setpoint setter checks the range queried by get_limits_from_dlc.
temp_actual and temp_setpoint read the diode temperature; the setpoint setter checks the range queried by get_limits_from_dlc.
The internal scan settings are enabled, output channel, frequency, amplitude, offset, start and end.

get_limits_from_dlc queries the piezo voltage, current clip, wavelength and temperature ranges; it hard-codes the scan frequency bounds 0.02 and 400 and notes that the maximum was not found in the manual.
The scan_frequency setter checks the value against the fmin and fmax bounds.
The scan range is the piezo voltage range for the PC output and the current range for the CC output; OutA and OutB have no range check.
freq_per_sec documents scan_freq in Hz and peak_to_peak in Vpp.
OutputChannel enumerates PC, CC, OutA and OutB; InputChannel enumerates Fine1, Fine2, Fast3 and Fast4.
set_parameters is not implemented: it raises NotImplementedError.
read_parameters only loads parameters from a JSON file; it does not read the instrument.
